svg.title: Handbook 13: The Birds: Gulls, Terns, Jaegers and Skua — normalized branding-panel template
svg.desc: Source-derived fixed wording, observed category-emblem presence and publisher treatment. Illustration field intentionally open and authors omitted. Panel geometry is normalized; this is not an exact illustrated-cover facsimile. Lettering is the closest inspected modern Helvetica43ExtendedLight comparison, not a confirmed historical font. Colours are approximate samples from uncalibrated photographs. No raster images or fonts embedded.
